description: Futures market investor (de-probabilised, multi-trade). The reserve/cash-in round is wrapped in while(1), so the investor (coalition) trades repeatedly and the realised profit ACCUMULATES into gain; the market (adversary) picks the price ceiling cap, moves the value within [0, cap], and may bar reservation a finite number of times per trade. Can the investor force a CUMULATIVE profit gain >= cap over the sequence of trades? Expected UNKNOWN -- soundness witness: a worst-case market neutralises every trade (moves the value down after each reservation), so even the accumulated gain cannot be forced up to cap (the quantitative original gives a probability < 1). cap is market-chosen, not fixed.
